A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EDDP research and contain 83 readable pages, including Appendices A.1-A.23. Text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison after matching relocated sections and displays.

before.justification: v3 Sections 6-7 and the appendices report original synthetic experiments, evaluations of deep image classifiers, ablations, and a chess-model correction experiment.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results in Sections 5-6 and the appendices, including quantitative comparisons and qualitative applications.

M1.justification: The direction-learning procedure, signal-vector estimation, losses, UFM/CFM manipulation, and optimization remain unchanged. Renamed method subsections clarify component roles without modifying Equations 3-13 or Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same synthetic task, Broden/Broden-Action concept datasets, Places365/ImageNet/Moments in Time evaluations, and clean/poisoned Chess Pieces scenarios. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain PCA, NMF, Natural, IBD, Pattern-CAVs, and the appendix UIBE/CBE variants. Architecture-specific baseline exclusions and comparator membership are unchanged.

E3.justification: The same model layers, cluster counts, data subsets, preprocessing, metrics, training settings, and testing procedures are reported. The shortened RCAV background does not change the evaluation protocol retained in Appendix A.13.

E4.justification: The subsampling, orthogonality, interpretability-loss, uncertainty-alignment, and target-margin studies are retained. Faithfulness tests, supervised-comparison analyses, and explanation/model-correction case studies also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain across-detector mean and standard-deviation reporting, RCAV label-permutation tests with 100 noise directions and Bonferroni correction, and ten random-direction trials for model correction. No statistical reporting procedure changes.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged; all 220 embedded images also match exactly. For example, Tables 13-14 retain poisoned-test accuracy of 0.34 for the original chess model and 0.65 for the corrected model in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, signal/distractor assumptions, loss formulations, manipulation derivations, and CCM decomposition are retained. Appendix changes only update section references; the new introductory explanation does not introduce a formal result.

C1.justification: The abstract and conclusion are unchanged. The rewritten introduction foregrounds CCMs as a central application already claimed and developed in v3, without expanding the scientific contribution or performance claims.

C2.justification: The introductory distinction between localization, intervention, and their combination in CCMs explains roles already documented in v3's background, applications section, and Appendix A.6. Interpretations of experimental findings and the substantive limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1, staged learning instructions, Table 16 hyperparameters, baseline implementation details, data-processing instructions, and Appendix A.22 hardware/runtime disclosures are retained. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: The bibliography contains the same works, and the substantive positioning against supervised directions, decomposition methods, SAEs, and concept bottleneck models is retained. Related Work moves from Section 2 to Section 7 with limited wording edits.

P1.justification: The introduction is substantially rewritten around the complementary purposes of encoding and decoding directions. Moving the full Related Work section after the experiments, condensing background explanations, and renaming method subsections substantially reorganize the narrative.

P2.justification: Figures and tables retain their content and design but are repositioned during reflow. Figure 3's caption is shortened, and Figure 14 moves from a page shared with Figure 13 and prose to a separate figure page. No displays are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v4 makes the purpose of the two directions and their combination in CCMs clearer at the outset, then brings readers directly into background and methods before the related-work survey. This improves accessibility while retaining the experiments, mathematical development, reproducibility details, and limitations, including the appendices.
